name: Malam-Team Holdings Ltd
summary: Malam-Team Holdings Ltd, established in 1963 and headquartered in Petah Tikva, Israel, is a prominent provider of comprehensive information technology services. The company, previously operating as Arad Investment & Industrial Development Ltd, will formally become Malam-Team Holdings Ltd in January 2025. The firm delivers an extensive range of technological solutions, including advanced cloud architecture services encompassing cloud computing, internet infrastructure, communication systems, and robust disaster recovery planning. They also specialize in cutting-edge cybersecurity, offering software solutions for information security, alongside the design and deployment of communication networks. Malam-Team is a key developer of software, creating applications for mobile and digital platforms, leveraging open-source and Microsoft technologies. Their development expertise spans specialized sectors such as public transportation, mainframe systems, legal and debt collection processes, as well as JAVA and Oracle solutions, complemented by professional guidance and training. Additionally, the company provides comprehensive outsourcing and managed IT services. They are proficient in the management and analysis of critical organizational data, including payroll, human resources, attendance records, and pension savings for a varied clientele that includes government bodies, large retail chains, the national defense sector, telecommunications firms, and high-tech companies. Malam-Team also offers expert consulting across numerous industries. This involves advising on, architecting, designing, and implementing complex system solutions, infrastructure software, communication networks, and information security frameworks. Their capabilities further extend to sophisticated software solutions for Business Intelligence (BI) and Big Data analytics, aimed at optimizing business performance and streamlining infrastructure and organizational workflows. This includes specialized platforms like Salesforce, Agile Point, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Cockpit 5, CAD, disaster recovery, customs clearance management, central management, information and document management, product lifecycle management, mobile applications, and human capital management.
